title: Garden of Tranquillity
start: Speak to Queen Ellamaria in the garden of Varrock Palace.

items.t: Watering can or magic watering can
3 cabbage seeds (6 recommended; can be acquired during the quest)
3 onion seeds (6 recommended; can be acquired during the quest)
1 marigold seed (2 recommended; can be acquired during the quest)
2 plant cures (the Cure Plant spell will not work)
Fishing rod or fly fishing rod (neither an oily fishing rod nor the fishing rod on the tool belt will work)

recommended.t: Activated Ardougne, Burthorpe, Canifis, Catherby, Draynor, Edgeville and Varrock lodestone
Additional 3 buckets of any variants of compost to protect the marigold, cabbage, and onion plants
Access to the fairy ring ALQ, or
Ghostspeak amulet and 2 ecto-tokens if Ghosts Ahoy has not been completed.
Runes for Cure Plant and Remote Farm can come in handy if doing more than one part at once.
An amulet of nature and/or some amulets of farming are extremely useful
A generous stock (6-12) of plant cure (can be acquired from farming shops during the quest)
Supreme growth potion (universal) (alternatively, sundry variant for onions and cabbages, leafy variant for marigold) and sunburst bracelet to skip growth cycles

rewards.t: 5000 Farming XP (During the quest, you will get even more experience from raking, composting, planting and harvesting)
An activated ring of charos, which is used to charm various NPCs to pay less for certain services, or get choices that are otherwise unavailable.
4 doses of supercompost potion, each of which can be used in a compost bin to turn compost into supercompost.
After the quest you can visit the garden and pick fruit from the White tree. Each fruit restores about 17% run energy and gives 12 Farming XP when picked.

steps.t: Talk to Queen Ellamaria in the garden of Varrock Palace. [Chat: Accept]
Talk to her again to receive a trolley that is needed later. [Chat: 1 How am I supposed to move statues all the way here?]
Equip the ring of charos and talk to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village. [Chat: 1 Queen Ellamaria has sent me to seek your guidance.]

sub.t: Show them a range of colours so that they can come to a compromise.
Take his generous gift even though you have no need for it.
It's absolutely, unquestionably the most interesting thing I've ever done!
Put on the silly helmet and jump into the cannon.
You of course Pkmaster0036, no one could ever challenge your greatness!
Ask me nicely and I might consider it.
No, especially not that wise old man, who doesn't look at all suspicious.

steps.t: Thanks for your help, Wise Old Man. [Chat: 1 Thanks for your help, Wise Old Man.]
If you don't have onion seeds, cabbage seeds or marigold seed, purchase them from Draynor Seed Market.

Charm Lyra at the allotments near Port Phasmatys (east of the Canifis lodestone). She is located where the four watering pot icons () are on the minimap. Accept to grow the patch of onions. [Chat: 1 Do you have any orchid seeds to spare? › 2 [Charm] If you tell me your problems, I may be able to help you. › 2 [Charm] Yes, I was wondering about that. › 2 [Charm] Times must be very hard for you. › 2 [Charm] Whatever you've done, I'm sure you had just cause. › 2 [Charm] And what is the nature of this fee that you pay? › 2 [Charm] If not yours, then whose blood are you offering? › 2 [Charm] How can you deal with so much guilt? › 1 That's a deal - I'll grow a patch of onions for you.]

Plant onion seeds in allotment patch. Planting in one patch is enough, planting two increases the success rate of healthy growth. This will take about 40 minutes, so continue the quest and come back later.

sub.t: Apply compost or supercompost to allotment patch to protect the crops.

steps.t: Charm Kragen at the allotments at Manor Farm, northeast of the Ardougne lodestone. Accept to grow the cabbages. [Chat: 1 Do you have any snowdrop seeds to spare? › 2 [Charm] You seem to be a little irritable, my friend. › 2 [Charm] I don't like to see a fellow human being so upset. › 2 [Charm] So what ails you, my friend? › 2 [Charm] Well, is there anything I can do for you? › 2 [Charm] So what can I do for you? › 1 That's a deal - I'll let you know when your cabbages are ready.]

Plant cabbage seeds in allotment patch. Planting in one patch is enough, planting two increases the success rate of healthy growth. This too will take about 40 minutes, so continue the quest and come back later. Rosemary must be fully grown to protect cabbage.

sub.t: Apply compost or supercompost to allotment patch to protect the crops.

steps.t: Use cabbage-port on your explorer's ring 3 or teleport to Draynor Village lodestone and run north-west past the wall to the farming patch in Falador farm.

Charm Elstan at the allotments north of Port Sarim and agree to grow some marigolds. [Chat: 1 Do you have any delphinium seeds to spare? › 2 [Charm] That is why I have come to an expert for advice. › 3 [Charm] Not just AN expert, Elstan - they say you are THE expert. › 2 [Charm] Oh no, I love listening to gardening stories... › 2 [Charm] Millions? Ah, just what I wanted to hear... › 1 Okay, I'll grow you some marigolds.]
Plant a marigold seed in the flower patch. This will take about 20 minutes.
Apply compost or supercompost to flower patch.
Add water till fully grown this will take 10 to 20 minutes.
Pick up the grown marigold.
Talk with Elstan and finish the dialogue. Aborting the dialogue between handing him the unnoted marigolds and receiving the seeds, you will have to grow the marigolds again.
Go to the Edgeville Monastery. Try to take a seed from one of Brother Althric's rose bushes.
Charm Brother Althric near the monastery rose bushes. [Chat: 2 [Charm] These are the most beautiful rosebushes I've ever seen.]
Unequip the ring of charos and use it on Edgeville's well east of the lodestone.
Try to take a seed from one of Brother Althric's rose bushes again.
Talk to Brother Althric.
Pick 4 pink, 4 white, and 4 red rose seeds (just click each type of bush once; you will pick 4 of them automatically).
Use your fishing rod on the well and equip the ring of charos.

Talk to Dantaera at the Catherby allotment farming patch with the ring equipped. Select all the options beginning with [Charm]. [Chat: 1 Do you know how I could grow a White Tree? › 2 [Charm] I think that there is something that you are not telling me. › 2 [Charm] A secret is a dreadful burden to have to keep to yourself. › 2 [Charm] Unless you allow me to do this she will die anyway.]
p: A player cuts a shoot from the White Tree.

steps.t: Interact with the white tree on Ice Mountain west of Edgeville, select secateurs.
Use the white tree shoot on a plant pot and water it.

It will take 3 minutes for the shoot to turn into a White tree sapling. It is recommended to plant the tree in the Queen's Garden as soon as possible, as this will take about 6 minutes longer to grow than the other plants.
p: Retrieving the ring from the well

steps.t: Charm Bernald who is south of the Taverley pub. [Chat: 2 [Charm] But it is the only way that these vines will be cured. › 1 I accept the deal.]
Use a plant cure on his grapevines.
Talk to Bernald again.
Run north and talk to Alain at the tree patch. Do not charm him. [Chat: 1 I need to ask you about strong plant cures. › 1 Are you sure there's nothing you can suggest?]
Use an essence on any anvil (you will find anvils walking north), grind the shards, use the rune dust on a plant cure.
Return to Bernald.
Use the new plant cure on his grapevines.
Talk to Bernald.
If you have no trolley, talk to Ellamaria in the Varrock Palace garden to receive one.
Teleport to Lumbridge, and at the entrance of the Lumbridge Castle courtyard, use the trolley on the southern statue.
Push the trolley east across the nearby bridge.

sub.t: Big-push the trolley east.
Big-push the trolley north twice.
Big-push the trolley east twice.

steps.t: Push it into the Queen's garden and use the "place" option when statue is close to the plinth. If you are not fast enough to push it and place it, it will disappear and respawn in Lumbridge.

sub.t: Big-push the trolley east three times.
Big-push the trolley south twice.
Big-push the trolley east.
Big-push the trolley south.
Big-push the trolley east.
"Place" the trolley.

steps.t: Teleport to Falador, and use the trolley on the statue of Saradomin south of the Falador lodestone.
After the cutscene, push it north out the gates and onto the garden plinth using the place option again.

sub.t: Pull the statue north.
Big-push the statue north 3 times.

steps.t: Push it into the Queen's garden and use the "place" option when statue is close to the plinth. If you are not fast enough to push it and place it, it will disappear and respawn in Falador.

sub.t: Big-push the trolley east three times.
Big-push the trolley south twice.
Big-push the trolley east.
Big-push the trolley south twice.
Push the trolley east.
Big-push the trolley south.
"Place" the trolley.

steps.t: You can now return to the patches and collect your seeds from the farmers (if you haven't done it already)

sub.t: Orchid seed (pink) and orchid seed (yellow) from Lyra east of Canifis.
Snowdrop seeds from Kragen north-east of Ardougne.
Delphinium seeds from Elstan north-east of Port Sarim.

steps.t: Plant the seeds back at the garden.

sub.t: Use your buckets of compost on the nearby plantpots. If having issues with "this patch needs weeding first", use regular compost, not supercompost.
Plant the rose seed, flower seeds, and white tree sapling in their spots.
Plant the vine seeds in the vine patch.
Plant the orchids in the plant pots. You may use Inspect option on a plant pot to find out what goes there.

steps.t: Wait for everything to grow which takes around 15 minutes; 20 for the White Tree if you haven't planted it yet.
p: A player pushing around a statue.

steps.t: Talk to the Queen.

Charm King Roald while equipped with the ring of charos (a). [Chat: 1 Ask King Roald to follow you. › 2 [Charm] Of course, your majesty - please forgive me. › 2 [Charm] The Queen asked me to bring you.]
p: Giving King Roald a tour of the completed garden.

steps.t: Quest complete!
